name: मुख्यमंत्री निकाह योजना
department: सामाजिक न्याय एवं दिव्यांगजन सशक्तिकरण विभाग
description: Assistance for eligible collective nikah arrangements under the MP scheme conditions.
benefits: ₹49,000 to the bride and ₹6,000 per bride to the organizing local body under the published scheme details
documents: Other documents required during local-body verification
application_steps: Apply through the prescribed local-body process
Eligibility is verified by the relevant local authority
Participate in the prescribed collective nikah event
